site.homeTitle: Waxtape Store · Waxtape skate clothing items for ReSkate | waxtape.store
site.homeDescription: Waxtape Store (waxtape.store) is the home of Waxtape skate: free skate clothing and board items for ReSkate (game mods). Tees, shorts, socks and decks, ready to download.

products.name: Amano Fleece
products.description: Black half-zip fleece covered in a hand-inked manga girl and wild brush splatter that wraps round to the back. Cosy enough for a winter session.

products.name: Player 2026
products.description: Cream mesh jersey with a V-neck and a tonal W. on the chest. Looks like a game-day kit, skates like a tee.

products.name: Sailor Howell
products.description: Boxy heather-grey tee with a big pink and lilac mirrored print down the front, finished with dripping gothic lettering.

products.name: Maji Chino
products.description: Baggy pink acid-wash denim shorts that hang past the knee, tagged with black spray scribbles. Loud on the ledge.

products.name: Midcalf Stairway
products.description: Mid-calf socks washed in a painted sunset sky, peach and baby-blue clouds all the way up. A stairway to heaven, ankle first.

products.name: Midcalf Twin
products.description: Ribbed red mid-calf socks with a flying cherub on each leg. A matching pair, the way angels come.

products.name: Letty Deck
products.description: A vintage pin-up cowgirl perched on a ranch fence, lasso in hand and a cactus at her boots. Saddle up.

products.name: Friendship Deck
products.description: Two cherubs locked in a hug under a baby-blue sky, Waxtape script running nose to tail. A deck for the homies.

products.name: Washed Reptile
products.description: Baggy acid-washed denim in a faded snakeskin print, finished with red contrast stitching. Cold-blooded, warm fit.

products.name: Altar Piece
products.description: A burning sacred heart under Waxtape script, flanked by roses that stare right back. Wear it like an offering.

products.name: Label Tshirt
products.description: Brick red tee that wears its name loud. A small waxtape hit on the chest, the big one across the back.

products.name: Original Sin
products.description: Boxy cream tee with Fine art on the front, all the mess on the board.

products.name: Straight Teeth
products.description: Smiley closeups say CHeeeese!!. Straight teeth not included.

products.name: Artist Longsleeve
products.description: Faded charcoal tee layered over cream long sleeves, the classic double-sleeve skate fit. Small mirrored "artist" wordmark on the chest, so it reads right in the mirror.

products.name: Cropped Hokki
products.description: Cropped off-white tee with a slim fit. This alien peeing takes a leak right on the chest.

products.name: Rose Shorts
products.description: Waxtape × Ed Hardy. Baggy dirty-wash denim shorts with a carpenter-style. It's got the style aswell as the iconic E.Hardy signature. Small wt logo on the pocket.
